def: having the power or skill to do something; the word 'of' and a verb-ing form follow it
able to be used or reached by people, such as a service offered through a website
easy to get in many places or for many people
the outside page at the beginning of a magazine or book
to fail to do something that you should do; a to-infinitive can follow it
to refuse to accept an offer or idea; a noun, not a to-infinitive, follows it
to present a piece of music, a play, or a show to an audience
happening only at particular times of the year, in a regular pattern
to do a job carefully and with steady effort
full of energy and excitement; active and cheerful (an event)
existing in large amounts; more than enough (supplies, rainfall)
to choose not to demand a payment that is normally required
lasting or meant to last for a very long time without change
the act of putting something extra together with something that already exists
to rise very quickly to a high level (prices, temperatures)
not quite; used right before a number to show it is a little less
facing something from the opposite side of a street or space
to obey a rule, law, or request
able to work together with another system without problems
having the right to receive something because you meet the conditions
to stay deeply interested and involved in what is happening
during the whole time of; from the beginning to the end of
